- When sentiment is strongly positive (≥0.67) in recent days, model tends to overestimate prices; reduce forecast by 1–2% for next 3–5 days.
- When sentiment is strongly negative (≤-0.22), model often underestimates; increase forecast by 1–2% for next 3–5 days.
- Model consistently overreacts to short-term spikes in sentiment; apply a 1–3 day lag correction after sentiment peaks.
- In early forecast windows (e.g., 1–3 days ahead), model shows mean reversion bias — adjust downward if recent price is above 30-day moving average.
- For 30-day forecasts, model tends to overshoot in the final 5–7 days; cap forecast at 1–2% below the 30-day moving average of prior 10–15 days.
- If sentiment history shows alternating high/low swings, model fails to smooth transitions; apply a 0.5–1.0% dampening factor to forecast volatility.
